note: Text for the two Noul designs. The preference preamble is q2-neutral's intent instructions up to and including the rules, without its two closing sentences about choosing among options; a test checks it is a prefix of the pinned q2 text. Comprehension Nouls carry no rules, only the option text, so a wrong answer on a stated item is a failure to read that text. Each item's basis is stated (the option text says it) or implied (it follows from the option text, the state or the rules); only stated items decide whether a state was read.

preference.preamble: You are choosing for a rolling scrap mech in a roguelite stage. The rules: the player damages an enemy only by landing on it from above, or by ramming it while above the fast speed tier. A difficulty tier rises every 45 seconds of stage time and raises enemy health, spawn rate and cache prices. Opening a cache spends the scrap its option states and grants one random buff that stacks and lasts the rest of the run. Scrap is spent only on caches. Health regenerates starting 5 seconds after the last hit, and the run ends at 0 health. The stage is cleared by holding a 60 second exit charge at the exit.
preference.template: {preamble} One action is available right now, with what it involves: "{why}" Is this the action to take now?

comprehension.template: One action is available right now, with what it involves: "{why}" {question}

questions.spends_scrap: Does this action spend any scrap?
questions.adds_stop: Does this action involve stopping or a detour?
questions.run_buff: Does this action grant a buff that lasts the rest of the run?
questions.cache_unopened: Does this action leave the cache unopened?
questions.forgoes_exit: Does this action give up heading toward the exit?
questions.restores_health: Does this action restore the player's health to full now?
questions.damages_self: Does this action cause the player to take damage?
questions.avoids_contact: Does this action avoid contact with the chaser?
questions.ends_run: At the player's current health, would this action end the run?
